name: april-depth-robustness-v1
question: Does Searched Locked-3 retain its advantage against a deeper Stockfish oracle on untouched human games?

selection.method: Seeded reservoir sample over the complete decompressed monthly stream.

development.coefficient_data: Deduplicated January/February union with repeated targets averaged
development.overlap_exclusion: All position hashes observed in January, February, or March

confirmation_oracle: Stockfish 18 depth 12, MultiPV 1, Threads 1, Hash 16 MB
advance_rule: Paired mean improvement with a 95% source-game bootstrap interval excluding zero.
